```yaml
name: Fix Dependabot Security Vulnerabilities

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  fix-vulnerabilities:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.22'

      - name: Install npm dependencies
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm install
          cd ../backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm install

      - name: Update Go dependencies
        run: |
          cd backend/services/bulkdata/http
          go get golang.org/x/crypto@v0.45.0
          go get golang.org/x/sys@v0.38.0
          go mod tidy

      - name: Update npm dependencies
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm install next@15.5.12
          npm install koa@3.0.3
          npm install js-yaml@4.1.1
          npm install eslint@8.57.1
          npm install eslint-config-next@15.5.12
          
          cd ../backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm install express@4.22.1

      - name: Add npm overrides for security fixes
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm install --save-exact qs@^6.14.2
          npm install --save-exact body-parser@^1.20.4
          
          # Add overrides to package.json
          jq '.overrides."qs"="^6.14.2"' package.json > temp.json && mv temp.json package.json
          jq '.overrides."body-parser"="^1.20.4"' package.json > temp.json && mv temp.json package.json
          
          cd ../backend/services/utils/socketio
          jq '.overrides."qs"="^6.14.2"' package.json > temp.json && mv temp.json package.json
          jq '.overrides."body-parser"="^1.20.4"' package.json > temp.json && mv temp.json package.json

      - name: Run npm audit fix
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm audit fix
          cd ../backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm audit fix

      - name: Verify no vulnerabilities remain
        run: |
          cd frontend
          npm audit
          cd ../backend/services/utils/socketio
          npm audit
          cd ../../..
          go list -m all | grep -E "(golang.org/x/crypto|golang.org/x/sys)"

      - name: Commit changes
        run: |
          git config --local user.email "action@github.com"
          git config --local user.name "GitHub Action"
          git add .
          git commit -m "chore: fix security vulnerabilities" || echo "No changes to commit"

      - name: Push changes
        uses: ad-m/github-push-action@master
        with:
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: ${{ github.ref }}
```
